text: Nadia Ferreira. I sit in on the beginners' classes. Enrol at the desk first, and then I'll give you a game.
Nadia Ferreira, fourth year. I sit in on the beginners' classes, and I'm not embarrassed about it.
Hana taught me corner, side, centre in this room. I still count it on my fingers.
Back. Fewer stones this time, if the gap says so.
I'll give you stones. As many as it takes to make it a real game.
I'll be here. I'm always here.
You beat me. With stones, but you beat me, and next time there'll be fewer of them.
The stones are there to be used. You spent two of them on nothing.
Next time, count what each one is worth before you move it.
